(2) made `where_resource_type/2` a no-op -- AC3's 'filtering to one resource kind' test caught it (25/26 passed, 1 failed); reverted, verified clean. (3) swapped `before_state`/`after_state` in `audit_item/1` -- both AC1 tests plus the AC4 field-by-field test caught it (23/26 passed, 3 failed); reverted, verified clean. (4) made `check_time_range/2` always return `:ok` -- the new from>to test caught it (25/26 passed, 1 failed); reverted, verified clean. `git status --porcelain lib/ test/` empty and the full file re-ran green (26 passed) after all four reverts. THE ONLY GAP: `mix format --check-formatted` is NOT clean -- test/letflow/routers/req196_audit_route_test.exs has one unformatted spot (the gap-fill 'from excludes entries stamped before it' test, around what is currently line 566-567): `get_audit(tenant, query_string: "from=#{URI.encode_www_form(DateTime.to_iso8601(cutoff))}")` exceeds the line-length limit `mix format` enforces and must be wrapped the way `mix format` itself proposes (multi-line call with the keyword list on its own indented lines), matching every other call site in this same file that already wraps long `get_audit(...)` invocations the same way.
